# OBSIDIAN-Docs Framework

Apply the following obsidian-docs framework guidance to the code or configuration you are changing. Check the stated preconditions and preserve behavior outside the authorized scope.

- Skill: `obsidian-docs`
- Source of truth: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/obsidian/skills/obsidian-docs/SKILL.md`
- Runtime agent config: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/obsidian/skills/obsidian-docs/agents/openai.yaml`
- Supporting docs: `$CODEX_HOME/plugins/obsidian/skills/obsidian-docs/references/`
